credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/sunflower.py. Reference photo sunflower/teen_alt.jpg by Loïc Mathieu (frontyardscientist, iNaturalist) (CC BY 4.0), https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/333769628: used as a drawing reference, not traced. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: EXCEPTION to the Crystal rule (approved by the Director): index 3 is the line's own gold, not the shared white, because a sunflower's identity is three hues (green leaves, gold rays, the brown seed disc) and the two-tone pilot lost the disc. Everything else follows the rule: full black outline, flat crescent shading, gold only on the rays, hull stripes, lit rims and glints. LUNGING, the base art re-rendered. Intro: the bud squeezes shut, swells, squeezes, swells and CRACKS: gold rays burst out of the foe-side seam with a glint, then ease back to the peeking tips. Only the head moves. Idle: the tips ease open. Sport: 'Italian White'. Helianthus annuus 'Italian White': cream-white rays round a near-black disc.
